title: Lexicographically smallest topological order with cycle reporting
notes: Hidden tests compare orders with the reference and validate every reported cycle edge by edge. They cover orders where a breadth-first queue is not lexicographically smallest, duplicate edges, cycles with tails and downstream nodes that are not on the cycle, self-loops, the error precedence of unknown and duplicate nodes over cycles, Unicode names and 5000-node chains and cycles that defeat recursive search.
